entries.degree: Description: UTRAN Server is a complete simulation tool developed for the purpose to test different third generation wireless entities in real time. This tool simulates the UE, NODEB as well as the RNC. It is used to simulate the user as well as the control plane protocols in radio access and core network interfaces according to the latest industry and manufacturer specifications. It works in the backend of EAST™. The UTRAN server can be used in LINUX as well in WINDOWS (NT, XP and Professional 2000) environments. This makes UTRAN server a flexible tool for load as well as regression testing in wireless telecommunication. In this version the performance of the UTRAN Server has been increased
